Hypertension

Ailment hypertension high-blood-pressure cardiovascular circulatory

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Chronic elevation of blood pressure in the arteries, increasing risk of heart disease, stroke, and kidney failure.

Symptoms

  • headache
  • dizziness
  • chest pain
  • shortness of breath
  • nosebleeds

Remedies for This Condition

  • Cell Salts
    Biochemical tissue salts (Schuessler salts) that help regulate fluid balance and cellular function in the body.
  • Celery Seed
    Natural diuretic that helps reduce fluid retention and uric acid buildup, beneficial for edema and gout.
  • Herbal Adjustment Formula
    Proprietary blend of herbs designed to support lymphatic drainage and fluid balance.
  • Hawthorn Berry
    Heart tonic herb that supports cardiovascular health by improving blood flow and strengthening heart contractions.
  • Omega-3 Fatty Acids
    Essential fatty acids (EPA and DHA) that support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and promote brain function.
  • Potassium Citrate
    Potassium supplement that helps prevent kidney stones and supports proper fluid balance; available in citrate form.

Affected Body Systems

  • cardiovascular
  • circulatory
  • renal

Severity Levels

  • stage-1
  • stage-2
  • hypertensive-crisis

Related Conditions

  • Arthritis
    Inflammatory joint disease; managed with dietary and herbal interventions.
  • Edema, Fluid Retention
    Excess fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling, typically in legs, ankles, or abdomen. Can be caused by heart conditions, kidney dysfunction, liver disease, or medication side effects.
  • Bladder Issues
    Bladder dysfunction including urinary retention, urgency, and discomfort, often linked to fluid imbalance and tissue salt deficiencies.
  • Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
    Infection anywhere in the urinary tract, most commonly in women. Characterized by burning pain during urination and frequent urges.
  • Kidney Issues
    Kidney dysfunction affecting fluid balance and waste filtration, leading to fluid retention, edema, and metabolic imbalances.
  • Lymphedema
    Lymphatic system dysfunction causing chronic swelling, usually in arms or legs, when lymph fluid cannot drain adequately.
  • Migraine
    Recurrent severe headaches often with visual disturbances, nausea, and sensitivity to light and sound.
  • Heart Failure
    Cardiovascular condition where the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs, often causing fluid buildup and edema.
  • Chronic Kidney Disease
    Progressive kidney dysfunction that can lead to kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. Often causes severe edema and electrolyte imbalances.
  • Asthma
    Chronic inflammatory disease of the airways that causes wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing.
  • Eczema & Skin Disorders
    Chronic inflammatory skin conditions causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin; includes eczema, psoriasis, and dermatitis.
  • Hypertension (High Blood Pressure)
    Chronic condition characterized by persistently elevated blood pressure in the arteries, increasing risk of cardiovascular events and kidney damage.
  • Kidney Stones
    Hard deposits of minerals and salts that form inside the kidneys and can cause severe pain when passing through the urinary tract.
  • Cardiovascular Disease
    Group of diseases affecting the heart and blood vessels, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and stroke.
  • Blood Sugar Imbalance
    Imbalances in blood sugar regulation, including hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
  • Joint Pain & Stiffness
    Chronic joint pain and stiffness from inflammation, injury, or degenerative conditions.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Immune System Weakness
    Weakened immune system leading to frequent infections and slow recovery.
  • Thyroid Dysfunction
    Underactive or overactive thyroid gland leading to hormonal imbalance and metabolic issues.
  • Menopause Transition
    Hormonal changes during the menopausal transition causing various symptoms.
  • Chemical Sensitivity
    Heightened sensitivity to chemicals, environmental toxins, and food additives that trigger immune responses.
  • Varicose Veins
    Enlarged, twisted veins typically in the legs due to poor venous circulation.
  • Metabolic Syndrome
    Cluster of conditions including high blood pressure, high blood sugar, excess body fat around the waist, and abnormal cholesterol levels.
  • Acid Reflux / GERD
    Gastroesophageal reflux disease causing heartburn and acid regurgitation.
  • Allergic Rhinitis
    Allergic inflammation of the nasal passages causing sneezing, congestion, and itching.
  • High Cholesterol
    Elevated cholesterol levels in the blood, increasing risk of cardiovascular disease.
  • Erectile Dysfunction
    Inability to achieve or maintain an erection sufficient for sexual intercourse.
  • High Blood Pressure
    Chronically elevated blood pressure requiring management.
